[[Andorra]] competed at the [[1988 Summer Olympics]] in Seoul, South Korea. Three competitors, all men, took part in three events in two sports.<ref name="Sports Reference">{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/summer/1988/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417093551/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/AND/summer/1988/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |title=Andorra at the 1988 Seoul Summer Games |access-date=5 July 2016 |work=Sports Reference}}</ref>
